name: Pampore

queries.result: First-party discovery found the Government of Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department JK-Revenue land-records portal, the Government of India DILRMP Pampore tehsil map-digitization page, and Jammu and Kashmir Revenue/Financial Commissioner material describing custody of land records and village/estate maps. The JK-Revenue public SPA loaded, but its anonymous API endpoints returned 401 and no parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.result: First-party discovery did not return a separate Urdu-language cadastral viewer or parcel API page. Related official Jammu and Kashmir Revenue/land-record routes were identified through the regional search, but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

discoveryMethod: separate English and Urdu first-party discovery plus bounded anonymous JK-Revenue viewer/configuration and API inspection
sourceReview: The Jammu and Kashmir Revenue Department is the local/UT cadastral and land-record custodian; the Financial Commissioner Revenue page describes custody and maintenance of land records, including estate/village maps. The DILRMP Pampore tehsil page is a national programme status source, not the local custodian. Pampore is evidenced in Pulwama district and the DILRMP page reports 399 of 399 cadastral maps digitized, 27 villages, one spatially verified village, 26 geo-referenced villages, one map linked to RoR, and Bhu-Naksha used for one map. This is custodian and digitization-status evidence, not a qualified parcel-feature response.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official JK-Revenue SPA loaded anonymously. Its current JavaScript bundle identified the API base https://d14fnjoywemmi.cloudfront.net/jklr-api and land-record routes, but no parcel geometry was present in the static page. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was used.

Current public JavaScript/configuration was inspected. It exposed authenticated land-record endpoints such as get-khasra-by-khasra-id, get-khasra-by-khata, and get-village-by-tehsil, but the bundle did not expose a public geometry endpoint or usable anonymous parcel response.
Anonymous API root rejected the request. No authentication attempt was made.
Anonymous district-list route rejected the request; no request body or credentials were supplied and no parcel data was obtained.
Anonymous district route rejected the request; no request body or credentials were supplied and no parcel data was obtained.

This is coverage-progress evidence only; it is not a parcel feature response.

Financial Commissioner Revenue material describes the custodian role and land-record contents including village/estate maps, Jamabandi, Girdawari, and mutation registers. Unsafe owner/title fields were not requested or retained.
